posts.text:
"In an age when too many public rituals collapse into slogans, performance, or self-congratulation, we yearn for something rarer and nobler. 

Let the names speak. Let prayer speak. Let music speak. Let grief speak. 

And, above all, let love of country speak—not loudly, not boastfully, but with the quiet confidence of a people who know that evil may wound America, but it cannot define her." - @cullystimson, Acting Director of the Legal Policy Center and Senior Legal Fellow of National Security.

posts.text:
On September 11, 2001, America was tested. What followed was not fear, but courage. Not division, but unity. Not surrender, but resilience.

Today, 25 years later, we remember that day of profound loss and honor the courage, sacrifice, and resolve that reminded the world of the enduring strength of the American people.

Never forget. 🇺🇸

NOW STREAMING: Preventable Tragedy

Sheridan Gorman was murdered in the early morning hours of March 19, 2026.

A freshman at Loyola University Chicago, Sheridan set out with friends to capture the northern lights over Lake Michigan. The night ended in heartbreak when she was shot and killed by Jose Medina, an illegal immigrant from Venezuela.

This is Sheridan's story, told by the ones who loved her most.

Learn more: https://t.co/XJ5wokSWj5
